bodyHtml:
从临床影像分析到成像材料设计，我们围绕真实需求开展研究，连接算法、数据与应用场景。
医学影像分析眼科智能诊疗可信医学 AI眼脑联合计算AI + 材料
Biomedical Image Analysis

医学影像分析

We develop methods to reconstruct, segment and interpret anatomical structures in biomedical images. By recovering how vessels and nerve fibres are connected, and improving image quality while preserving local detail, we aim to support quantitative analysis, disease diagnosis and treatment planning.

聚焦血管与神经等细长结构，开展拓扑重建、动静脉分类、图像增强与精细分割。

Topology Estimation
Reconstruct tree-like structures to reveal anatomical connections between curvilinear components.
Artery/Vein Classification
Distinguish retinal arteries and veins for vascular analysis, including the arteriolar-to-venular ratio (AVR).
Topology EstimationArtery/Vein ClassificationVessel/Nerve Segmentation
查看相关成果 →

Medical Image Enhancement

医学图像增强

Non-uniform illumination, low contrast and noise can hinder image interpretation. We study structure-preserving enhancement and denoising across fundus, OCTA and confocal microscopy images, retaining the fine detail needed for subsequent analysis.

Vessel/Nerve Segmentation

医学图像分割

Accurate segmentation of vessels, nerve fibres, retinal layers and lesions enables quantitative measurement of anatomical changes. Our work addresses diverse imaging modalities and structures with complex geometry or weak boundaries.

Computer-Aided Screening and Diagnosis of Ocular Diseases

眼科智能诊疗

We investigate computer-aided screening and diagnosis using fundus photography, OCT, OCT angiography and other ophthalmic imaging modalities. The research links image enhancement, anatomical segmentation and disease-related feature analysis to clinical assessment of ocular conditions.

面向糖尿病视网膜病变、青光眼、黄斑病变与病理性近视等疾病，研究影像辅助筛查与诊断方法。

Angle-Closure Assessment
Characterize the anterior chamber angle in anterior segment OCT (AS-OCT), including open, appositional and synechial configurations.
Fundus / OCT / OCTARetinal BiomarkersAngle-Closure Assessment
查看相关成果 →

Multimodal Ophthalmic Imaging

多模态眼科医学影像

Different imaging modalities capture complementary information about the eye. We study fundus, tomographic, angiographic and microscopic images to analyze retinal, anterior segment and corneal structures in ocular disease research.

Disease Screening and Diagnosis

疾病筛查与诊断

We analyze vascular geometry, retinal layer thickness, lesion appearance and other image-derived features to investigate disease biomarkers. These measurements support research on automated screening and quantitative assessment of ocular and related systemic conditions.

Trustworthy Medical AI

可信医学人工智能

We study how medical image models generalize across devices, institutions and imaging conditions. Research on uncertainty estimation, domain generalization and source-free learning aims to improve the reliability of image segmentation when annotations are limited or data distributions change.

关注跨设备、跨中心场景下的泛化能力与不确定性，探索低标注条件下更可靠的医学影像分析。

Uncertainty EstimationDomain GeneralizationSource-Free Learning

Eye-Brain Joint Computing

眼脑联合计算

The retina offers a non-invasive window into brain health. We investigate relationships between retinal microvascular features, white matter changes and cognitive function, and explore how retinal biomarkers and multimodal learning can inform models of eye-brain associations.

通过眼底影像特征提取、病理特征分析与眼脑映射，探索脑健康相关的无创风险评估方法。

Retinal BiomarkersBrain HealthMultimodal Learning
查看相关成果 →
AI for Materials Design and Discovery

AI + 材料

We explore AI models that connect material composition and structure with physical properties and imaging performance. Property prediction, virtual experiments and inverse design can help investigate candidate imaging materials and guide the design–synthesis–evaluation cycle.

探索材料物化特性与成像性能的映射，研究智能设计、虚拟实验和性能预测方法。

Property PredictionInverse DesignImaging Materials
查看相关成果 →

AI-Assisted Materials Discovery

人工智能辅助材料发现

Learning from materials data can support candidate screening and knowledge discovery. We explore models of composition–structure–property relationships to inform synthesis, simulation and optimization of imaging materials.
